svg.data-weight-note: 27 lb (12.24 kg) with power supplies and fans installed (guide Table 31)
svg.data-throughput: up to 8 Tbps unidirectional and 16 Tbps bidirectional (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-breakout-ports: 16 x 200 GbE + 48 x 100/50/25/10 GbE + 2 x 10 GbE, or 72 x 100/50/25/10 GbE + 2 x 10 GbE, or 74 x 10 GbE (datasheet Table 2)
svg.data-network-port-speeds: ports 0 to 47 default to 100 GbE with SFP56-DD optics; ports 48 to 55 default to 400 GbE with QSFP-DD optics (guide, Setting Port Speed and Channelization)
svg.data-power-measurement-note: Maximum at 40 C ambient with SR optics at 100 percent load with IMIX traffic; typical at 25 C with DACs at 50 percent load with IMIX traffic, excluding transceivers (datasheet Table 4)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 127 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 12 A at 100 to 127 VAC, 9 A at 200 to 240 VAC (guide Table 20)
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating -40 to -72 VDC, 40 A maximum (guide Table 27)
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, 1+1, each able to carry the whole switch; both should be installed, on feeds A and B
svg.data-fans: six fan modules, redundant at the rotor level; the switch runs 240 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-airflow-note: AFO is front-to-back (port-to-FRU); AFI is back-to-front (FRU-to-port); no mixing of fans and supplies of different direction
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F), for AFO and for AFI (guide Table 30, datasheet Table 3)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent noncondensing, operating and non-operating
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 1829 m (6000 ft) at 0 to 40 C (guide, Environmental Specifications; datasheet Table 3, AFI with 400G ZR optics is limited to sea level at 40 C)
svg.data-storage: two internal 100 GB SSDs (datasheet Table 2); the guide's RMA procedure describes two SSDs
svg.data-software: Junos OS Evolved, first release 23.4R1-S1-EVO for the QFX5130-48C and 23.4R2-S1-EVO for the QFX5130-48CM
svg.data-optics-sfp-dd: 100 GbE SFP56-DD cables and 400 GbE AOCs on ports 0 to 47 (guide, Network Ports for QFX5130-48C)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400 GbE QSFP-DD optics on ports 48 to 55; breakout cables for 100/25/10 GbE (datasheet)
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: ports 56 and 57 take 10 GbE modules only, on the rear management panel
svg.data-macsec: QFX5130-48CM only, with the S-QFX5KC3-MACSEC-X licence: 32 x 100G SFP56-DD and 4 x 400G QSFP-DD ports support MACsec, up to 9.6 Tbps bidirectional (guide, product overview)
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps
svg.data-emc: FCC 47 CFR Part 15; ICES-003 / ICES-GEN; BS EN 55032; BS EN 55035; EN 300 386; CISPR 32; CISPR 35; IEC/EN 61000 series; AS/NZS CISPR 32; VCCI-CISPR 32; BSMI CNS 15936; KS C 9835; KS C 9832 (datasheet Table 6)
svg.data-substances: RoHS; TSCA; POPs; WEEE; California Prop 65; REACH (datasheet Table 6)
